nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) public isSigner; tracks which addresses are signers
address[] public allSigners; full list of signers including disabled/duplicated ones
uint public activeSignersCount; number of currently active signers
mapping(address=>Script) public scripts; script state per scriptAddress
address[] public scriptAddresses; list of known script addresses
uint public constant CHUNK_SIZE = 100; paging size for UI helper functions
constructor(): registers deployer (msg.sender) as the first signer
sign(address): signer approves a script; increments signCount and calls checkQuorum
execute(address): delegatecalls the approved script and marks it Done/Failed
cancelScript(address): cancels a New/Approved script, only callable via MultiSig itself
addSigners(address[]): adds new signers, only callable via MultiSig itself
removeSigners(address[]): removes signers, only callable via MultiSig itself
checkQuorum(uint) internal view; abstract quorum rule implemented by derived contract
getAllSignersCount(): view helper returning allSigners.length
getAllSigners(uint offset): paged view helper returning signer addresses and active flags
getScriptsCount(): view helper returning scriptAddresses.length
getAllScripts(uint offset): paged view helper returning script state and signCount
PreTokenProxy.checkQuorum(uint): quorum = signersCount > activeSignersCount/2
msg.sender: external caller identity used for authorization throughout the contract
scriptAddress.delegatecall(bytes4(keccak256("execute(address)")), scriptAddress): executes arbitrary code in the MultiSig context
script.signCount = script.signCount.add(1): arithmetic increment of signature counter
activeSignersCount++ in addSigners: arithmetic increment of active signer count
activeSignersCount-- in removeSigners: arithmetic decrement of active signer count
scriptAddress parameter of sign(address)
scriptAddress parameter of execute(address)
scriptAddress parameter of cancelScript(address)
signers array parameter of addSigners(address[])
signers array parameter of removeSigners(address[])
signersCount parameter of checkQuorum(uint)
offset parameter of getAllSigners(uint)
offset parameter of getAllScripts(uint)
Script storage script = scripts[scriptAddress] in sign
Script storage script = scripts[scriptAddress] in execute
loop index i in addSigners
loop index i in removeSigners
loop index i in getAllSigners
signerAddress = allSigners[i+offset] in getAllSigners
loop index i in getAllScripts
scriptAddress = scriptAddresses[i+offset] in getAllScripts
bool result returned by execute, set from delegatecall outcome

edges.reason: constructor records msg.sender as first signer and pushes it to allSigners
sign() authorizes via require(isSigner[msg.sender]) and records msg.sender in script.signedBy
execute() authorizes via require(isSigner[msg.sender]) before delegatecall
cancelScript() requires msg.sender == address(this), i.e. only via the MultiSig itself
addSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this)
removeSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this)
sign() reads isSigner[msg.sender] to check signer authorization
sign() reads and mutates scripts[scriptAddress] (state, signCount, signedBy, allSigners)
sign() calls checkQuorum(script.signCount) and approves the script if quorum is reached
sign() performs script.signCount.add(1) incrementing the signature counter
execute() reads scripts[scriptAddress] and writes state to Failed/Done
execute() forwards the user-supplied scriptAddress into a delegatecall
delegatecall to the arbitrary scriptAddress executes external code in MultiSig context and can re-enter sign/execute/cancelScript before state settles
cancelScript() sets scripts[scriptAddress].state to Cancelled
addSigners() reads and sets isSigner[signers[i]]
addSigners() pushes new signers onto allSigners
addSigners() mutates activeSignersCount
addSigners() executes activeSignersCount++ inside the signer-adding loop
removeSigners() reads and clears isSigner[signers[i]]
removeSigners() mutates activeSignersCount
removeSigners() executes activeSignersCount-- inside the signer-removing loop
PreTokenProxy.checkQuorum reads activeSignersCount to compute the majority quorum
getAllSigners reads allSigners[i+offset]
getAllSigners reads isSigner[signerAddress] to report active status
getAllSigners uses CHUNK_SIZE as the paging bound of its loop
getAllSignersCount returns allSigners.length
getScriptsCount returns scriptAddresses.length
getAllScripts reads scriptAddresses[i+offset]
getAllScripts reads scripts[scriptAddress].state and signCount
getAllScripts uses CHUNK_SIZE as the paging bound of its loop
scriptAddress parameter of sign indexes the scripts mapping
scriptAddress parameter of execute is both the scripts key and the delegatecall target
scriptAddress parameter of cancelScript indexes the scripts mapping
signers array parameter of addSigners is iterated to register new signers
signers array parameter of removeSigners is iterated to drop signers
signersCount parameter feeds the abstract checkQuorum rule
offset parameter of getAllSigners indexes into allSigners
offset parameter of getAllScripts indexes into scriptAddresses

normalization_plan.reason: parameter flows directly into scripts[scriptAddress] access inside sign()
parameter supplies the delegatecall target and scripts key in execute()
parameter only selects the script entry cancelled by cancelScript()
parameter is the sole input iterated by addSigners()
parameter is the sole input iterated by removeSigners()
parameter is the only argument of the quorum check function
parameter only offsets the read loop in getAllSigners()
parameter only offsets the read loop in getAllScripts()
storage pointer local used exclusively within sign()
storage pointer local used exclusively within execute()
return flag derived from the delegatecall outcome in execute()
loop temporary holding allSigners[i+offset] in getAllSigners()
loop temporary holding scriptAddresses[i+offset] in getAllScripts()
